items.title: How we test here
items.content:
# How we test here

Read this before changing anything.

## The order of work

1. A requirement becomes an issue.
2. The issue gets at least one test case linked to it.
3. The test case runs against a mock before it runs against a real service.
4. A failure becomes a defect linked back to the issue.

## What 'done' means

- The test case passes twice in a row, not once.
- The evidence is attached to the run, not described in a comment.
- The issue links to the change that closed it.

items.title: What an agent must not do alone
Reading a failed run
items.content:
# Reading a failed run

A failed run is one of four things. Decide which before filing anything.

| What you see | What it usually is | What to do |
|--------------|--------------------|------------|
| The same step fails every time | a real defect | file it, link the run |
| It fails only in parallel | a test that shares state | fix the test, do not file |
| It fails after a deploy | a contract change | check the contract first |
| It fails once, then passes | flaky | mark it flaky, do not file |
